text:
maria: Pushed a Grafana prototype showing cache coverage heatmaps (route x customer) and a token-saved overlay. Wanted quick eyeballs before we promote to the console dashboard.

sam: Nice. Quick question: how are you calculating "coverage"? is it unique-prefix hits / total requests or token-level hit-rate?

maria: Token-level hit-rate. Coverage = tokens_served_from_prefix_cache / total_request_tokens over the window. I also have a cold-hit ratio panel for first-request misses.

leo: Saw this after the latest kernel-selection change we rolled last week — did you slice by model variant? the small-quantized paths have way lower hit-rate for short prefixes in our traces.

maria: Good call. There's a per-model dropdown but I didn't break out variant-level filters. Adding model_variant and route_tags next.

anya: Can we add an annotation layer for the batching-heuristic flip on 2027-02-19? I suspect the batching change reduced KV cache warmup because we spread prefixes across more batch lanes.

maria: Adding an event marker for that deploy now. Also including a panel that shows avg KV-cache lookup latency pre/post to verify.

sam: Also: what's the cache keying scheme you used? I want to confirm we're not accidentally including transient session ids.

maria: Key = sha256(model + route + normalize(prefix) + tenant_id)  (normalize does whitespace collapse + lower). Example: 
```
key = sha256(f"{model}|{route}|{tenant_hash}|{normalized_prefix}")
```
We intentionally avoid session ids.

leo: Cool. Could we expose a small sample of top-100 keys per-customer (hashed) to see hot prefixes? That helped root-cause two regressions last quarter.

maria: I can add a table panel: top prefixes by token-saved and hit-rate, masked / hashed for privacy.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: dashboard update pushed to staging (uid: dash-cc-2027-03-05). CI checks passed.

anya: For observability we should compute "effective token savings" = tokens_saved_from_cache * model_cost_per_token (approx). That gives ops-oriented dollar impact per-customer and helps prioritize warmup.

sam: Agree. Can we get a route-level rollout scoreboard: before/after token-saved % and the % of requests that are cold?

maria: Added a small composite panel: {"token_saved_dollars", "cache_hit_rate_pct", "cold_request_pct"} across time. Will wire up alerts if token_saved drops >15% for top-ten customers.

leo: Regressions note: I found one case where kernel auto-select switched to a fused-kernel and KV lookup latency jumped ~2x for long prefixes. Might be a backend scheduling issue. I'll open a short PR to pin the kernel on that path while we investigate.

anya: If we pin kernels, make sure we include the fallback policy in the dashboard so SRE can see pinned-vs-auto counts.

maria: Will do. Final ask: feedback on legend/colormap — I used viridis but if product wants high-contrast for accessibility we can change.

sam: Viridis is fine. Also can we add a tiny inline explainer for the key calc and warmup assumptions? New teammates always ask.

maria: Done. Plan: merge to main after one more pass, add variant-level slices, and create an alert for token-saved drop. Thanks all :thumbsup:

infra-bot: ci-bot: release pipeline triggered for dash-cc-2027-03-05 (staging -> prod in 2h if no manual hold).
